summary: Synth Patch Hero is a browser extension that creates synthetic audio patches for music production. It runs locally in Chrome or Edge without requiring any external API keys. The tool is suited for musicians or producers who want quick, in‑browser patch generation, leveraging a novel UI‑driven approach. Reviewers praise its intuitive, fun learning experience, while noting occasional finicky matching and missing UI controls. The project is very new, with minimal community size and modest documentation, so it is best considered an experimental add‑on.

github.description: A struggling musician is in charge of building patches for new artists, learning the basics from oscillators, filters, adsr, and more!
